name: coedit-monorepo
description: Distributed block-based collaborative editor (Yjs CRDT + NestJS)

scripts.build:lib: npm run build -w @coedit/shared && npm run build -w @coedit/block-core && npm run build -w @coedit/renderer
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:lib && npm run start:dev -w @coedit/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @coedit/shared && npm run typecheck -w @coedit/block-core && npm run typecheck -w @coedit/renderer && npm run typecheck -w @coedit/server
